import pytest
import math

@pytest.mark.parametrize("input_val, expected", [
    (0.0, 0.0),  # zero value
    (1.0, 1.0),  # normal value
    (-1.0, -1.0),  # negative value
    (0.5, 0.5),  # mid-range value
    (10.0, 10.0),  # large value
    (math.inf, math.inf),  # infinity
    (-math.inf, -math.inf),  # negative infinity
    (None, None),  # None value
    (0, 0),  # integer zero
    (-0, -0),  # negative integer zero
])
def test_std_normal(input_val, expected):
    # test normal cases
    assert math.sqrt(input_val) == expected
    assert math.isclose(std(input_val), expected)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("input_val, expected", [
    ([], None),  # empty list
    ([0], 0.0),  # single zero value
    ([1], 1.0),  # single positive value
    ([-1], -1.0),  # single negative value
    ([0, 1], math.sqrt(2)),  # mixed values
])
def test_std_list(input_val, expected):
    # test list inputs
    if input_val:
        assert math.isclose(std(input_val), expected)
    else:
        assert std(input_val) is None

@pytest.mark.parametrize("input_val, expected", [
    ("0", 0.0),  # string zero
    ("-1", -1.0),  # string negative value
    ("0.5", 0.5),  # string mid-range value
    ("hello", None),  # string non-numeric value
    ("None", None),  # string None value
])

    # test string inputs
    try:
        assert math.isclose(std(input_val), expected)
    except ValueError:
        pass

    ([-1, -2, -3], -1.0),  # decreasing values
])
